title: HMW DNA Extraction from Red Algae for Long Read Sequencing
author: Benoît Vacherie
materials: QC results obtained on different species.

steps.title: Prepare extraction buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare 10 mL extraction buffer (per 200 g of algal material) in a 50 mL tube.

steps.title: Cool mortar and pestle
steps.instruction: Place mortar and pestle on ice and cool with liquid nitrogen until bubbling stops.

steps.title: Grind frozen sample
steps.instruction: Add 200 mg frozen red‑algae sample to the cooled mortar and grind to a fine powder (~2 min).

steps.title: Transfer powder to buffer
steps.instruction: Transfer the powder into the 10 mL extraction buffer and vortex briefly.

steps.title: Add β‑mercaptoethanol
steps.instruction: Add 20 µL β‑mercaptoethanol (catalog #97622‑10X1ML) to the mixture and vortex for 5 s.

steps.title: Incubate at room temperature
steps.instruction: Incubate the tube at room temperature for 1 h with agitation at 300 rpm.

steps.title: First centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 8 500 × g, 4 °C for 10 min with low deceleration (acceleration 9, deceleration 6).

steps.title: Transfer supernatant
steps.instruction: Transfer the clear supernatant to a new 50 mL tube.

steps.title: Add organic reagents
steps.instruction: To the supernatant add 0.1 vol (1 mL) absolute ethanol, 0.25 vol (2.5 mL) 3 M potassium acetate, and 1 vol (10 mL) chloroform:isoamyl alcohol (24:1, catalog #25666); vortex twice for 5 s each.

steps.title: Precipitation incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the mixture for 20 min at –20 °C.

steps.title: Second centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 8 500 × g, 4 °C for 20 min with low deceleration (Acc 9/Dec 6).

steps.title: Transfer aqueous phase
steps.instruction: Gently transfer the aqueous (upper) phase to a new 50 mL tube.

steps.title: RNase A treatment
steps.instruction: Add 2 µL RNase A (100 mg mL⁻¹, catalog #19101) and incubate 30 min at 37 °C.

steps.title: Chloroform extraction
steps.instruction: Add 1 vol (10 mL) chloroform:isoamyl alcohol (24:1, catalog #25666), vortex twice for 5 s each.

steps.title: Second –20 °C incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate for 20 min at –20 °C.

steps.title: Third centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 8 500 × g, 4 °C for 20 min with low deceleration (Acc 9/Dec 6).

steps.title: Transfer aqueous phase again
steps.instruction: Gently transfer the aqueous phase to a new 50 mL tube.

steps.title: Isopropanol precipitation
steps.instruction: To the supernatant add 0.8 vol (~8 mL) isopropanol, 0.1 vol (~1 mL) 3 M sodium acetate, and 0.2 % (~2 µL) β‑mercaptoethanol; invert to mix and incubate 1 h at –20 °C.

steps.title: Fourth centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 8 500 × g, 4 °C for 20 min with low deceleration (Acc 9/Dec 6).

steps.title: Ethanol wash
steps.instruction: Carefully discard supernatant, resuspend pellet in 1 mL cold 70 % ethanol.

steps.title: Transfer to LoBind tube
steps.instruction: Transfer the resuspended DNA to a 1.5 mL DNA LoBind tube (catalog #022431021).

steps.title: Pellet wash centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 5 000 × g, 4 °C for 10 min with low deceleration (Acc 9/Dec 6).

steps.title: Air‑dry pellet
steps.instruction: Discard supernatant and air‑dry pellet at room temperature for 5–10 min.

steps.title: Resuspend DNA
steps.instruction: Resuspend pellet in 50–100 µL 1× TE buffer.

steps.title: DNA solubilisation
steps.instruction: Incubate for 2 h at 55 °C or overnight at room temperature to fully dissolve DNA.

steps.title: Store DNA
steps.instruction: Store the DNA solution at 4 °C.

steps.title: Quantify and assess DNA
steps.instruction: Measure concentration with a Qubit HS assay, assess purity with a Nanodrop (260/280 and 260/230 ratios), and estimate fragment size with a Tapestation or Femto Pulse.

steps.title: Optional size selection
steps.instruction: If needed, deplete short fragments using SRE size‑selection kits (SRE XS, SRE, or SRE XL) according to the manufacturer’s instructions.
